column1: # Values the authored Compose tree must carry that the forward generator does not emit, one per row:
# directory, type, name, plural category (`-` for a <string>), text. Cells escape \\ \n \t \r as the oracles do;
# `#` starts a comment. Read by `verifyStringsRoundTrip` (strings.VerifyStringsRoundTripTask).
# All five are base-only `@string/` aliases of `values/donottranslate-strings.xml`, which Android re-resolves in the
# *requesting* locale rather than copying. The forward generator leaves them out of these two directories because
# Compose already returns Android's value there — and it does, as long as the alias is still an alias:
#   values-b+tl    change_providers_img_des = @string/home_change_provider_img_des, and values-b+tl defines that
#                  target itself ("Change Provider", untranslated). An identical language beats an equivalent one
#                  (ResTable_config, tl and fil are equivalent), so Android reads tl's own target, not fil's.
#   values-b+zh+TW change_providers_img_des, duplicate_cancel, sort_cancel and plurals/episodes resolve to targets
#                  values-b+zh+TW defines, so Android stays in Traditional Chinese.
# Flattening the alias to literal text moves the decision from the target to the alias, and the alias is base-only:
# Android would then read values-b+fil for `tl` and the default English for `zh-TW`. Writing the resolved value into
# the directory restores the identical-locale win. Each text below is the cell `oracle-baseline/lookup.tsv` froze
# for that request before the flip, so the post-flip lookup diff is zero lines rather than six.
values-b+tl
values-b+zh+TW
values-b+zh+TW
values-b+zh+TW
values-b+zh+TW
values-b+zh+TW
